title: Time Jump: Wednesday 05:30, Overnight Status

fields.scenarioTitle: Flyway: HPAI Control Area, Checkpoints & Depopulation
fields.narration: We're moving the clock forward overnight. It is now 05:30 on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. That is 21 hours and 40 minutes since Tuesday's 07:50 presumptive result. It's 27 degrees and clear in Larkin, and breakfast is going out of the Larkin Lutheran Church kitchen right now. Overnight, the Board of Animal Health issued its quarantine order on IP-1, 'Ridgeline Farm', and published the control area at 14:10 on Tuesday. The IMT chose water-based foam for barns 1 to 4. The Commissioners' 11:00 meeting and any National Guard request depend on the Director's 10:20 call: if a county emergency declaration and a Guard checkpoint request went in, the state approved 8 soldiers who began staffing sites at 20:00; if not, the Sheriff covered the sites with Pell deputies and overtime. Depopulation crews finished barns 3 and 1 on Tuesday. The second shift started at 22:00 and finished barn 2 at 04:40. Barn 4 is in progress, and the IMT expects it to be done at about 08:00. That is also when the second shift hits its 10-hour cap. The 24-hour depopulation goal arrives at 07:50, two hours and twenty minutes from now. All 11 checkpoint sites were staffed through the night, but Site 9 had only one deputy from 01:00 to 05:00. Carcass trucks have been lining up at the Calder County Regional Landfill since Tuesday evening, and the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency approval is still unsigned. The permit desk has 23 open requests. The national reference laboratory in Ames has still not reported. Update your status board for 05:30 Wednesday and pick up from here.
worldState: Clock: 05:30, Wednesday, October 21, 2026. 27°F, clear, calm. Sunrise is a little after 07:40.

The Board's quarantine order on IP-1 'Ridgeline Farm' was issued Tuesday. The published control area reads: 'Infected zone 3 km, buffer zone 7 km, 10 km control area. Federal planning values; the Minnesota plan governs.'

IP-1 depopulation: barns 3 and 1 were completed Tuesday on the first shift. Barn 2 was completed at 04:40 on the second shift. Barn 4 (about 15,500 toms) is in progress, and the IMT's estimated completion is about 08:00.
The second-shift crews started at 22:00 Tuesday and reach their 10-hour cap at 08:00. The IMT has not named a relief crew for after 08:00.
24-hour depopulation goal: 07:50 Wednesday, 2 hours 20 minutes from now.
Checkpoints: all 11 sites were staffed overnight. Site 9 had one deputy from 01:00 to 05:00 and has had two since 05:00.

Calder County Regional Landfill (Larkin Road): 11 sealed, covered carcass trucks are staged at the gate. The first one arrived at 17:10 Tuesday. None has been unloaded, because the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency approval is still unsigned. The landfill's allocation for this response is 120 tons per day, with 24-hour operation if the state approves.
Permit desk: 23 open movement permit requests. 9 of them were submitted more than 18 hours ago.
The national reference laboratory in Ames has not reported. IP-1 is still a presumptive positive.
The next county planning meeting is at 16:00 today.
fields.facilitatorNote: Let players rebuild the board before you prompt them. If nobody brings it up, ask the Director whether anything overnight meets a CDSDSL 10 escalation trigger. The landfill queue has now been waiting more than 12 hours, which meets the trigger. Site 9 was short-staffed, not unmanned, so it is a judgment call. Watch whether OPS works out that barn 4 finishes about 10 minutes past 07:50, right at the shift cap, and whether they stretch the shift or plan a relief crew. Don't settle what the Board, the IMT or MPCA decide. Those are the state's decisions.

instructorNote: This card moves the exercise into Wednesday's queue-and-permit problems. Players must restate the status and test the escalation triggers: the landfill wait has passed 12 hours, and Site 9 ran on a single deputy. Ops should check that barn 4's estimated finish around 08:00 and the 10-hour shift cap are reconciled against the 07:50 goal without breaking the cap.
